notes_for_editor: Thin record. tnlandforms gives coordinates, county and an unexplained note, 'fire tower rd? gw'. The Forest Lookouts North Carolina index does not list LaGrange. The LaGrange Historic District registration form is cited only for the town description; a search of its text finds no mention of a fire tower. Real estate listings for Fire Tower Rd in La Grange, NC appear in search results; they are not history sources and were not used, but a human could check whether a road of that name matches the note. Status and access are left unknown. The story text is about 91 words, under the 120-word target because no further source was found. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the note was quoted without its last word; the full note 'fire tower rd? gw' is now quoted, and a sentence that copied the registration form's wording was reworded.
